title: File:Messiria elder speaks to Abyei arbitration decision.jpg
ImageDescription: A Misseriya elder speaks out on the border demarcation decision by the Permanent Court of Arbitration in the Hague.

title: File:ASC Leiden - NSAG - van Es 5 - 035 - The market of Zalingei. Four young men in white clothes with white headscarves - Zalingei (Zalinjay), Central Darfur, Sudan - 12-28-1961.tif
ImageDescription: The market of Zalingei. Four young men in white clothes with white headscarves are posing for the photographer, a boy is holding a loaf of bread (or a cup of cereals?). One or two black women are watching. A smiling boy is holding up a paper with a portrait of a soldier. Wicker stalls in the background. On the left a veiled woman with a square braided crate? Everything on sand.

title: File:ASC Leiden - NSAG - van Es 5 - 032 - The market of Zalingei. A group of men and women with basketsr - Zalingei (Zalinjay), Central Darfur, Sudan - 12-28-1961.tif
ImageDescription: The market of Zalingei. A group of men and women with baskets and bowls on the floor and head under a large tree. Donkeys in the distance. Women are laughing at the photographer.
